name: memhop-trajectory
summary: L6 trajectory manual: append agent operation events per session, list sessions, read trajectories, view stats (to judge crystallization worthiness), delete trajectories
trigger: need to record operation trajectories, view trajectory events, judge crystallization timing or clean up trajectories; trajectory l6 event operation log

resources.name: AppendTrajectory
resources.desc: Call on important operations (tool calls, subtasks, key decisions); EventType=turn_start/tool_call/tool_result/subagent_spawn/subagent_done/context_inject/llm_request/llm_output/turn_end, Payload=event content (truncated to 4KB), L4Ref=related L4 archive (optional), Timestamp=Unix ms; Seq auto-assigned
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string","description":"Session ID (16-char hex)"},"event_type":{"type":"string","description":"turn_start/tool_call/tool_result/subagent_spawn/subagent_done/context_inject/llm_request/llm_output/turn_end"},"payload":{"type":"string","description":"Event content (truncated to 4KB)"},"timestamp":{"type":"integer","description":"Unix ms"},"l4_ref":{"type":"string","description":"Related L4 archive ID (16-char hex, optional)"}},"required":["session_id","event_type","payload","timestamp"]}

resources.name: ListTrajectorySessions
resources.desc: List the domain's L6 sessions (16-char hex id, event counts, last-append time); use to discover sessions worth crystallizing or cleaning up

resources.name: ReadTrajectory
resources.desc: Read all trajectory events of a session (ascending by Seq)

resources.name: TrajectoryStats
resources.desc: Trajectory stats: total events, per-type counts, last event timestamp; use to judge whether the session is worth crystallizing (tool-call count threshold)

resources.name: DeleteTrajectory
resources.desc: Delete a session's whole trajectory; the session can no longer be crystallized afterwards

steps.action: Keep appending events during operations (must for important ones)
Check stats to judge crystallization timing
Discover sessions to crystallize or clean up
Read when event details are needed
Clean up when a session ends or the trajectory is useless
